name: cdkd-integ-deploy-force-quit-rollback
description: Integ fixture for a force-quit / closed-terminal deploy's rollback journal (#6894): an SSM parameter, an SQS queue and a Lambda function, then a Lambda-backed custom resource that sleeps 90 s on Update, then a parameter and a queue behind it. A deploy force-quit (two SIGINTs) or hung up (SIGHUP) while the custom resource's update is in flight must leave a rollback journal that cdkd rollback reverts.
